title: brain.json
description: BRAINLLM app configuration. Precedence: flag > BRAIN_* variable > brain.json > defaults.

output.description: static requires portable .html/.js/.css output and rejects request-time server dependencies. Honored by build, doctor and MCP. auto preserves normal server selection.

staticOutput.description: Optional generated asset folders for static output only. Defaults preserve the normal layout. Paths are safe relative URL directories; . means the output root. Public originals retain their source paths; packaged SDKs preserve their complete layout beneath the js folder.

fonts.description: Hashed public/imported fonts; defaults to the assets directory unless explicitly overridden. Packaged SDK relative trees stay intact.

precompressed.description: Emit useful .gz/.br/.zst variants. false emits ordinary raw web files only; does not remove authored public files.

hostFiles.description: Emit optional _headers/_redirects and nginx/Caddy configuration hints. false requires configuring headers and redirects on the host.

compression.description: Precompression profile: small preserves production size optimization; fast spends less build time encoding gzip/Brotli/zstd. Both retain raw files, useful compressed variants and actual-byte budget checks.

inlineCss.description: Allow small stylesheets inline; false emits generated CSS as separate hashed files in the css folder. Dynamic style attributes are unaffected.

js.description: Generated JavaScript, workers and packaged SDK trees (default _b).

images.description: Generated hashed image copies (default _b); an override also places social images beneath this directory/og.

assets.description: Other generated assets such as fonts and imported binaries (default _b).

trace.description: `brain trace`, the development capture of `brain run`. It never reaches a production build.

redact.description: Extra field names to hide, on top of passwords, tokens, cookies and secrets

brainVersion.description: Exact BRAINLLM version this app's source targets. Written by `brain new`; `brain upgrade` reports the changes since it and `brain upgrade --apply` advances it.

docs.description: Keep docs/app (generated by `brain docs`) up to date on every `brain build`; also on when docs/app/index.md exists.

speculation.description: Speculation Rules on pages that navigate with a full document load: public static targets are prefetched on hover. false removes them.

server.description: Limits shared by brain run and the production server (dist/server.mjs). BRAIN_MAX_BODY_KB, BRAIN_TIMEOUT_MS and BRAIN_RPC_LIMIT override them at run time. brain check reports an invalid value as B0707.

maxBodyKB.description: Largest RPC or form body in KiB (1024 bytes); a larger body is answered with 413. Raise it for files sent as base64 in RPC arguments.

timeoutMs.description: Deadline for a server function call and for load(); past it the server answers 504.

earlyHints.description: Send 103 Early Hints from the Node server. Leave off behind nginx below 1.29, which takes a 103 as the final response. Link headers are always sent. BRAIN_EARLY_HINTS=1 or 0 overrides it.

rpcPerMinute.description: Calls per client IP and function per minute; past it the server answers 429 with Retry-After.

csp.description: Content-Security-Policy settings of the built site.

scriptSrc.description: Exact hosts pages may load scripts from, besides the site's own. A literal script outside this list is reported as B0811; a third-party script tag still needs integrity (B0123).

mediaSrc.description: Sources for audio and video, besides the own origin. Allows blob: and exact HTTPS origins; HTTP is local-loopback only. Omitted keeps default-src fallback.

workerSrc.description: Sources for Worker, SharedWorker and ServiceWorker scripts, besides the own origin. Allows blob: and exact HTTPS origins; HTTP is local-loopback only. Omitted preserves the standard worker directive fallback.

frameSrc.description: Origins pages may embed in an iframe, besides the site's own. A literal iframe outside this list is reported as B0811.

formAction.description: Exact origins native forms may submit to, besides the own origin. HTTPS or local-loopback HTTP only; no wildcard, path, blob or socket sources. Omitted or [] keeps form-action own-origin only.

connectSrc.description: Origins pages may call besides the site's own, which is always allowed. Replaces the broad `https: wss:` of `connect-src`; [] means the own origin only. Omitted keeps the broad form and `brain check` warns B0795.

site.description: Public origin, e.g. https://example.com. Prefer PUBLIC_SITE_URL in .brain_env.

base.description: Path the app is hosted under: starts and ends with "/", e.g. "/app/". brain run, brain build and brain start serve every URL under it.

backend.description: Explicit native backend HTTP origins and opt-in live resource rooms; no credential values.

origins.description: Canonical public HTTP(S) origins without path or trailing slash. Defaults to the origin of PUBLIC_SITE_URL. --origin replaces this list.

sockets.description: Absent/false disables native live resources. Every socket origin must also occur in the resolved HTTP origins; no implicit CORS expansion.

update.description: prompt: a new service worker waits until the page calls applyUpdate()

routes.description: Service worker strategies for same-origin data paths; first match wins

maxAge.description: 30s, 10m, 1h, 7d or seconds; omitted = no age limit

failOnSuspectedLeaks.description: Make `brain doctor` fail on B0601, an instance still alive after GC. Off by default: B0601 is a suspicion and is reported as a warning.

minScores.description: Minimum score per category for `brain lighthouse`. Accessibility and SEO default to 100 because they depend only on the page; performance and best-practices are checked only when set.

siteName.description: Public display name for SEO and discovery files. Overrides root name without renaming the package.

focus.description: Terms the site wants to be known for, most relevant first. `brain seo audit` reports where each one lives and how pages link to it; more than 3 is a warning, and nothing here blocks a build

markdown.description: Publish a Markdown copy of every indexable page (/pricing.md), link it, and serve it on the page URL when Accept prefers text/markdown (Vary: Accept); false turns all three off

credit.description: Close every generated page with a small "By BRAINLLM <version>" line linking to the BRAINLLM home page; false removes it

feed.description: Write rss.xml (site feed, like WordPress /feed) and <section>/rss.xml for each section without a content collection, linked from every page; false turns them off

sections.description: Write sections.json, the manifest of every section (title, description, home page, feed and pages with URL, Markdown copy and lastmod), linked from every page; false turns it off

trailingSlash.description: One URL per page for crawlers: never = /about/ answers 301 to /about; always = /about answers 301 to /about/; ignore = both are served. Folded into the same single hop as redirects.json

canonicalHost.description: Send every other host (www., an old domain) to `site` with one 301; loopback hosts are never redirected. Needs `site`

ai.description: AI crawler policy in robots.txt: allow (training, answers, search), search-only (no training) or block (no AI crawler)

og.description: Generated Open Graph images: only for pages without og:image, for every page, or never

search.description: Deprecated: still accepted and adds nothing. Google retired the sitelinks search box in 2024.

news.description: Google News sitemap from these content collections

analytics.description: First-party behavior analytics stored in the native backend's Postgres (docs/backend/analytics.md). On by default when a native backend runs; false turns it off.

countryHeader.description: Proxy header with an ISO country code, e.g. cf-ipcountry

budget.description: Build byte budgets. mountMs and heapMB are planned browser measurements and are rejected until implemented.

viewKB.description: Maximum KiB (1024 bytes) of emitted JS, CSS and HTML per route. Uses gzip when smaller, otherwise raw bytes; includes the conservatively reachable JS graph, including lazy chunks. Excludes images/fonts. Exceeding this value fails build.

ext.description: Published file names: web (.html/.js/.css) or brain (.brain/.jsbrain/.cssbrain, with Content-Type set by _headers, nginx and Caddy). brain build --ext overrides it.

lint.description: Per-rule level, e.g. {"B1307": "off"}. Only the quality families (B09xx-B13xx) can be changed; other overrides are ignored.

targets.description: Browser support target for B21xx warnings. Explicit years must not be newer than the pinned web-features dataset.
